hookCategories.description: Immediately offers a tangible asset like a prompt, guide, or formula, establishing authority and providing instant utility.
examples: the prompt I've been using is:
the formula for pricing AI projects (save it):
manus for niches, claude for hooks = $15k/m passive info income
Founders: 2026 Landing Page Checklist:
hookCategories.template: Here's the [Resource Type] I use to [Achieve Specific Outcome].

hookCategories.description: Leads with a clear benefit or a solution to a known problem, appealing directly to the audience's goals and pain points.
examples: My Claude Code now runs several parallel Gemini agents for research and coding thus saving a ton of tokens.
you can scrape any authenticated page with claude code in like 2 mins…
AI does 90% of our initial GTM strategy formulation all in just these 6 prompts.
hookCategories.template: [Tool/Method] lets you [Achieve Desired Outcome] while avoiding [Common Pain Point].

hookCategories.description: Creates curiosity by hinting at a hidden method, story, or non-obvious opportunity, compelling users to read more to find the answer.
examples: there’s an insane amount of MONEY hiding where most people don’t look.
found out my friend makes $20k/month BUYING macbooks
a guy who's sold $20M+ in info products told me something that changed how i see marketing forever
There's an AI coding approach that lets you run seriously long-running AI agents (hours, days) that ship code while you sleep. I've tried it, and I'm not going back.
hookCategories.template: There's a [Adjective] method for [Task] that few people know about.

hookCategories.description: Challenges a common belief or states a strong, unexpected opinion to grab attention and spark discussion.
examples: Being a generalist is a superpower, but it’s also a dopamine trap.
Money is a proxy for energy.
Stop using Apollo for all your leads
buying google ads on competitor brand names is obvious
hookCategories.template: You've been told [Common Belief] is true. It's not. The reality is [Your Contrarian Take].

hookCategories.description: Implies the reader is missing out on a significant opportunity or advantage, creating a fear of being left behind.
examples: If you're not using Google's AI studio "build" feature to prototype MVPs, you're sleeping on a super power.
I DON’T UNDERSTAND WHY PEOPLE AREN’T USING GOOGLE GEMINI FOR SIDE HUSTLES IN 2026.
hookCategories.template: If you're still not using [Tool/Technique] for [Goal] in 2026, you're falling behind.

hookCategories.description: Engages the reader by asking a direct question that also teaches them something new or highlights a feature.
examples: Did you know you can animate your nanobanana infographics using Veo2 model in Google AI Studio? https://t.co/J74J0eBROf
Did you know you can use skills in Codex?
hookCategories.template: Did you know you can use [Tool] to [Achieve Surprising Outcome]?

hookCategories.description: Starts with a personal story (often dramatic or relatable) to build a human connection and draw the reader in.
examples: Yesterday I cut my knee open with a machete while chasing goats through the thicket in a ravine.
i had $57,000 in debt
Your prospect opens your message and sees you sitting in their favorite café, in their city, holding a mug with their logo on it.
hookCategories.template: [Timeframe], I experienced [Unexpected Event] that taught me [Key Lesson about Tech/Work].

hookCategories.description: Uses a surprising or shocking statistic to create concern and establish credibility.
examples: ✍️ over 80% of the vibe coded apps have critical security vulnerabilities
hookCategories.template: A recent study shows [Shocking Percentage]% of [Group] are affected by [Unexpected Problem].

hookCategories.description: Shares a personal, often non-work-related moment to build authenticity and create a personal brand connection.
examples: Out on the ridge with the goats.
The bread is ready to go into the wood fired oven. https://t.co/IWWg3LZcUF

topPerformingHooks.hook: There's an AI coding approach that lets you run seriously long-running AI agents (hours, days) that ship code while you sleep. I've tried it, and I'm not going back.
topPerformingHooks.whyItWorks: It promises a powerful, almost magical solution to a major pain point for developers (long-running tasks) and ends with a strong personal endorsement.

topPerformingHooks.hook: a guy who's sold $20M+ in info products told me something that changed how i see marketing forever
topPerformingHooks.whyItWorks: It leverages authority ($20M+) and promises a transformative insight, creating immense curiosity about the secret.

topPerformingHooks.hook: AI does 90% of our initial GTM strategy formulation all in just these 6 prompts.
topPerformingHooks.whyItWorks: This is a concrete and highly impressive claim of efficiency. It provides a specific number (90%, 6 prompts) which makes it more believable and impactful.

topPerformingHooks.hook: Being a generalist is a superpower, but it’s also a dopamine trap.
topPerformingHooks.whyItWorks: It resonates with a large segment of the tech audience, validates their identity ('superpower'), and introduces a thought-provoking downside ('dopamine trap').

hookFormulas.formula: I had [Specific, Relatable Problem]. Here's the exact [Process/Tool] I used to fix it.
